source: Binoy děku i alit a oyo
target: This dress is given to me

source: Dë katenig a madelang a gemetin de Surot a Dumaget Bulos, gegemit a mag simbolo a pegemit de Pilipenu ki English tolad ni c, f, j, ñ, q, v, x, z de pagbeybey ni mga idem a surot
target: For consonants that are seldom used in Dumaget Bulos language, the symbols used in Filipino and English will be used such as c, f, j, ñ, q, v, x, z in spelling of borrowed words

source: Be i ok ay geabut de surol a nagkopugtus de patinig, sosolat yo ni hiwalay
target: When ok follows to the word that ends in vowels such as a, e, i, o, u, it will be written separately

source: I kuwit ay pegemit de pagbukod-bukod ni ngalan o begey a pe olo isin
target: Comma is used to separate succession of names or items

source: Ikaw i pegemit sa halip a ide dehil I getokuy ni gesurot ay gekaanak diya
target: Ikaw is used to refer to a person who is younger or at the same age of the speaker

source: I ni a i kahulogen a ni a pegemit de pagpapaabuyà ni agta a petokuy
target: ni is used in introducing person

source: I gitling (-) ay makmuk a gemit. lo ay i mga sumusunod
I glottal stop a de inapoan ni surot ay pesulat a (')
target: Words with glottal stop at the end of the word have is presented by this mark (')
The garden is by the river.

source: I aku de inapoan ni surot ay nagkappani ok
target: ako at the end of a word becomes ok

source: Anu kayo incyedi ku de kamu?
target: What can I do for you?
We gave the papers to them

source: I kaaduwa a timog ni tetik e ay nalilikha de tipide a mga surot bege io ay geabut de mga tetik b, d at g. Io ay gekaduman ni tinog a malapatenig y de unahan a mage alon kung kaya't pesolat a ē
target: The second sound of letter e is produced when it follows to letters b, d and g. Thus, it is written as Ēē

source: Bekot i eya no duman de tindehan?
target: Why is he going to the store?

source: I kuwit ay pegemit de pagbukod-bukod ni sugnay a eyen gekaeisin mula de sugnay a gekaeisin
target: It is used to separate a dependent clause that comes before an independent clause
The child is reading a book

source: Gepokaluto ok ni kanin ki ikan.
I kuwit ay pegemit de loub ni pangungosap para de saglit a pagtegil
target: Comma is written within a sentence for a pause

source: Papalanu ka gesaing?/papalanu ka a gepakaluto?
Dinu a papangan i pe hande mu?
Biyen mo i eya ni ikan
Buot ku a makitan i ama mu.
target: I want to see your father.

source: De mga idem a surot mula de surot a Tagelog a te kambel-katenig. ambel-katenig, pebukod i kambel-katenig de pamamag-etan ni pagdugeng ni patenig de pag-etan nio
target: Borrowed words from Tagalog with consonant cluster is separated into two syllables when written in Bulos language

source: I mga surot a idem de Pilipenu ke English a ugnay di a pegemit ni Surot a Dumaget Bulos ay pesulat de pamamaraan ni Dumaget Bulos
target: Most of the borrowed words from English and Filipino that are frequently used in Dumaget Bulos are spelled following the rules in Dumaget Bulos writing

source: Pegemit i hanga a tetik de pagsolat ni pamaget a aklat, tula, kuwentu ki pangyayadi
target: Capital letters are used in writing the title of a book, poem, story and event

source: I tande a panantu (?) ay pegemit de lawis ni pangungosap a getantu
target: The question mark (?) is used at the end of the interrogative sentences

source: Pegemit i ni bege i petokuy a ge surot ay de alani diya
target: ni is used if the speaker is referring to something which is near to her/him
The house in Tagpis is ours

source: Eyen nappatud a gemitin i e de i oi i de e be nobowon mababago i kahulogen ni surot
target: Letters i and e cannot be used interchangeably in words that would mean different meaning

source: I Pamamaraan ni Pagsolat ni Surot a Dumaget Bulos
Binoy ni Onad i olam dě asù
target: The viand was given by Onad to the dog

source: Buot na a mangamit ni biges.

target: I am a Dumaget, I am proud of it.
thanksgiving during harvest season/offering to the dead

source: I ni a i kahulogen a ng a pegemit de pagpapaabuyà ni begey, lugel ki pangyayadi a getokuy
target: ni which means ng is used in introducing things, place and events
The house in Tumagtag is ours

source: Tilawon a surot i pegemit ni pang-personal ki pang-impersonal de Surot a Dumaget Bulos
target: Three words are used in personal and interpersonal

source: Pegemit i hanga a tetik de simula ni pangungosap
target: Capital letters are used at the beginning of the sentence
The house of man is big

source: I kaduwa a tinug ni e ay mage malapatenig a y de unahan bege abut de katenig a b, d pati g. lo ay pesolat ni ě
target: Some words produce the second sound of e which has semi-vowel sound of y when it follows to consonants b, d and g. This is represented as ě.
The wild boar being caught is theirs

source: Pegemit i nun bege i petokuy a ge surot ay de alayu diya
target: nun is used if the speaker is referring to something which far from her/him

source: Pegemit i gitling de impit a tinog de gitna a surot
target: Hyphen is used to indicate glottal stop at the middle of the word

source: I gebigkas de mga patenig a Surot a Dumaget Bulos ay tolad di de gebigkas de mga patenig a alpabetu a Pilipenu maleben de tetik e a gekaduman ni kaduwa a tinog
target: All the vowels have the same sounds as those vowels in the Filipino alphabet except for vowel e which has second sound when it follows to letters b, d and g

source: Te mga surot a te kambel-katenig a magkamokha a tetik at pebigkas de magkahiwalay a pantig
target: There are words with consonant cluster of the same letter that are pronounced in separate syllables
Ide which is used in plural form is also used in singular if referring to elder persons

source: I tetik o ay pepalitan ni u de mga idem a surot a umapu de Tagelog
target: Letter o is replaced by u in borrowed words from Tagalog language

source: Gemit ni mga tetik o ki tetik u
target: Uses of letters o and u

source: I ide a sorot a paggelang a pegemit din de gekatande. Subelit, io a pegemit la de paggelang de hepag, beyaw, panuwangan pati de gekatande a mangayun ni ayùn
target: Ide is a word of respect referring to elder person is only used to refer to sister-in-law, mother-in-law, father-in-law and relative elders of husband or wife

source: manga panoka ide a agid tolad ni bilokaw, ayù, adwes ki kakmukan ayù
target: leaves that produce sour taste such as bilukaw, ayù, adwas and others

source: Eyen di bobowon o pepalitan be i sosolat ay tangi a ngalan ni kaagtaan ki lugel
target: Spelling of borrowed words used in proper names of persons and places are not changed

source: mora – niyog na mura pagengu – magulanglubi – puno ng buko

target: The house in Sinilaban is yours

source: I i a i kahulogen a ang a pegemit de pagpapaabuyà ni mga begey, lugel ki pangyayadi
target: i which means the is used in introducing things, place and events.

source: Binoy na i maman di Bulala
target: He/She gave the maman to Bulala

source: Te mga surot a te kambel-katenig a magkabukod a tetik a pebigkas de eisin a panti
target: There are words with consonant cluster of different letters that are pronounced in the same syllable

source: I mga gemit a i at e
target: Uses of letters i and e

source: I impit a tinog o glottal stop

target: It could also be said as
I want to get a casserole.

source: I Surot a Dumaget Bulos ay te dalawampu't tiluwan (23) a tinog. Io ay te anim (6) a patenig at labing-pitu a katenig kabilang di i mga impit a tinog (glottal stop).
target: There are twenty-three (23) sounds in the Dumaget Bulos Language. Six (6) of these are vowels and seventeen (17) are consonants including the glottal stop.

source: I sabi ni Inoy "Wet ampus a gelakad tuwi a abi"
target: Mother said, "Do not go out at night." / Mother said, "Do not walk at night."

source: Mga sangkap de paglotu ni sinugno
target: Ingredients in cooking doup known as sinugno

source: I de a i kahulogen a sa a pegemit dē pagpapaabuyà ni bègey o bègey a tinanggep, pinamuoyen o binoy pati lugel o lugel a pinamuoyen, inapuan o kinàngan
target: dē which means sa is used in introducing things or things being received

source: I tetik e de Surot a Dumaget Bulos ay te aduwa a tinug. I ona a tinug ay parehu de tinug ni e de alpabetu a Pilipenu
target: Letter e has two sounds. The first sound is the same with the sound of letter e in Filipino alphabet.

source: De pagsolat ni ngalan ni adow ke bolan, pegemit e pamamaraan ni pagbeybey ni Surot a Dumaget Bulos
target: Names of days and months are spelled following the rules in Dumaget Bulos

source: I glottal stop a de pag-etan ni surot ay pesolat a gitling (-)
target: Glottal stop that is found iin the middle of a word, between consonant and vowel is represented by hyphen (-)

source: I di a i kahulogen ay kay ay pegemit de pagpapaabuyà a agta a biniyen o tumanggep ni isin a bègey
target: di which means kay is used to introducing person who receives something

source: I atte ay gekatande de gesurot kaya naadi gemitin na i ide de paggelang ki eyen i buot a sasabi ay makmuk. De Tagelog ginarnit pa la un sina bilang paggelang de petokuy a eisin a agta dehil gekatande io de gesurot.
target: Ate is an older sister of the speaker so ide can be used to refer to her, even the person being referred to is only one

source: Nagboy ni bulaklak i Isap di Bulinggit
target: Isap gave a flower to Bulinggit

source: Bege matande i petokuy i Ikaw a nagkappane ikamu (misan isin la i petokuy.) lo a tande a paggelang de pesan a gekatande
target: If the speaker is referring to an older person, ikamu is used instead of ikaw, even the person being referred to is only one. This is an expression of respect to elder person
I have come from the barrio.

source: I kuwit ay pegemit de pagsolat ni pitsa
target: Comma is used when wiriting dates

source: I panande a pegemit ni Dumaget Bulos ay tolad pala ni Pilipenu ki English
target: Common punctuations that are used in Dumaget Bulos are the same in Filipino and English

source: I tuldok (.) ay pegemit de lawis ni pangungosan a gesalaysay
target: The period (.) is used at the end of declarative and imperative sentences

source: Amuyong, tumabu ka ngona ni orat
target: Amuyong, fetch a pail of water

source: Pegemit a gitling de mga surot a peliwet a te kakmukan a kahulugen be eyen io peliwet
target: It is used in words that are pronounced twice which has different meaning if not repeated
He is going to the store.

source: I panipi("") ay pegemit de pagsolat ni pagsurot ni kaagtaan o mga surot a pebigkas
target: The quotation marks (" ") are used to enclose direct speech and quotes

source: I i a i kahulogen a si a pegemit de pagpapaabuyà ni agta
target: i which means si is used in introducing person

source: De mga surot a gemut a peliwet, io ay eyen pegemitan ni gitling
target: Hyphen is not used to rootword even if it is repeated

source: Hali napatod ka di a tumotul.
Anu i buot mu a amitin?
target: What do you want to get?
How many siblings are you in the family?
